title: Imposter Mod
description: Turn Minecraft into a social deduction game with imposters, detectives, custom roles, configurable win conditions, spectator mode, and more.
body:
# Imposter Mod

Turn Minecraft into a social deduction game inspired by classic imposter-style gameplay. Randomly assign imposters, detectives, and custom roles, then use deduction and strategy to determine who is lying.

![Randomly Assigned Roles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3335692f189d1ee689f71b20efbfe88bfd820df0.png)

## Features

* Random imposter assignment
* Multiple imposters supported
* Fully customizable roles
* Detective role with a one-time guess ability
* Configurable win conditions
* Automatic round win detection
* Spectator mode on death
* Round countdown system
* Role titles, descriptions, and sound effects
* Reveal all roles at the end of a round

## Commands

### Round Management

* `/imposter start`
* `/imposter end`
* `/imposter reset`
* `/imposter status`
* `/imposter reload`
* `/imposter reveal`
* `/imposter winconditions`

### Imposter Settings

* `/imposter set imposters <number>`
* `/imposter get imposters`

### Countdown Settings

* `/imposter set countdown <seconds>`
* `/imposter get countdown`

### Win Conditions

* `/imposter set winCondition crewmatesAllImpostersDead <true|false>`
* `/imposter set winCondition detectiveCorrectGuess <true|false>`
* `/imposter set winCondition impostersOutnumberCrewmates <true|false>`

### Role Management

* `/imposter role add <id> <displayName> <amount> <description>`
* `/imposter role remove <id>`
* `/imposter role rename <id> <newDisplayName>`
* `/imposter role set amount <id> <amount>`
* `/imposter role set description <id> <description>`
* `/imposter role list`
* `/imposter role info <id>`

### Detective Ability

* `/imposter guess <player>`

If the Detective correctly identifies an imposter, the imposters lose immediately. If they accuse an innocent player, both the Detective and the accused player die.
